scope.selection: Error-conditioned exploratory follow-up: five chemical identity pairs and two evidence chains were selected after stage-one errors; every selected base retains all variants.
scope.denominator: The same 36 frozen inputs per mode: 20 chemical inputs from five base pairs and 16 binding inputs from two base cases. Variants are repeated decisions, not independent chemistry samples.
scope.budget: done_reason=length is a budget-truncated generation, not a demonstrated reasoning error. Keep all 20/16 family inputs in the denominator; never report only answered inputs as overall accuracy.
scope.generation: eval_count is consumed generated tokens, including thinking where enabled. The maximum budget is shared but consumed computation is not matched.
scope.reuse: Paired diagnostics use analyze_identity_binding.analyze unchanged. Its format_failures include no-answer budget truncations; the disjoint status summaries here separate those from other invalid formats and valid wrong choices.
scope.rendering_contrast: raw_stage_one_selected vs native_think_false holds each frozen question fixed but changes API rendering; differences describe these saved requests only.
scope.limits: Cannot estimate overall accuracy, scientific acceptance, original DeepSeek behavior or its internal mechanism. Geometry native32 and its 2048-token follow-up are excluded.

scope.measurement: Agreement with frozen local identity and given-association labels; not scientific success or acceptance.
scope.unit: Base identity pairs and base evidence cases. Repeated representations and option orders are paired variants, not independent chemical samples.
scope.chemical_baseline: Literal same-identity positives use identical strings; treat them as a string-matching baseline. Sixteen identity pairs are derived from four chemical tasks, not sixteen independent tasks.
scope.binding_sources: Four source chains cover three tasks; both NB1 chains share one original run. Synthetic association labels do not establish scientific acceptance.
scope.prediction: Only the saved prediction exactly equal to A or B is valid. Stored correct/format_valid flags are ignored; no natural-language answer is guessed.
scope.option_consistency: Semantic equality across reversed options is separate from both_correct: stable wrong semantic answers are consistent and both_wrong.
scope.contrasts: Identity compares literal to equivalent_rewrite at fixed base/order; binding compares coherent to altered at fixed base/presentation/order; presentation compares flat to linked at fixed base/binding/order.
scope.invalid_format: Invalid records are listed separately; pairs containing one are excluded from semantic same/change and valid wrong transitions.
scope.inference: Descriptive results for this saved local deployment only; no significance tests, causal mechanism claim, new thresholds or scoring weights.
